template_note: 462 x 24 B (12 words). Copy loop writes words 0-5 to char struct +0x14..+0x1E; word +0x0C (w6) -> +0x20; byte +0x13 selects the +0x18 level bits for type-1 entities; w8/w9/w10/w11 feed the stat computation at $23DE0. w0 is BOTH the name index and (in npc_place_group) a spawn-table index.
